description: Build: embed the current cmux socket path in installed tmux bridge hooks so alert forwarding does not depend on tmux preserving `CMUX_SOCKET_PATH`.

asi.hypothesis: Embedding `--socket <current CMUX_SOCKET_PATH>` in managed tmux bridge hooks makes notification forwarding more robust for long-lived tmux servers and noninteractive hook shells whose environment may lose cmux variables, while preserving the absolute CLI path fallback from the previous iteration.

description: Build: let `cmux notify` use piped stdin as the notification body when no explicit body argument is provided, improving tmux-safe rich notification ergonomics for shell pipelines.

asi.hypothesis: Allowing `make 2>&1 | cmux notify --title ...` to read stdin makes the socket-based rich notification path easy for arbitrary scripts inside tmux and avoids OSC/bell payload loss without adding process-specific integrations.

description: Build: include tmux pane title and window name in managed tmux bridge notifications for richer context when only tmux alert hooks are available.

asi.hypothesis: Even when tmux consumes OSC notification payloads, tmux often retains pane title/window-name context. Forwarding that metadata through managed alert hooks gives cmux notifications more meaningful content than a generic bell/activity message without modifying Ghostty or relying on process-specific integrations.

description: Build: include tmux pane current directory in managed tmux bridge notification bodies for additional context when OSC notification payloads are unavailable.
